issues.detail: The Hebrew 'וְכָל מַשְׁקֶה' means 'and every drink' or 'and all drink' (referring to any beverage), but the Chinese renders it as '一切酒政' which means 'all wine officials' or 'all wine administration' — this is a mistranslation of the noun 'מַשְׁקֶה' (drink/beverage) as '酒政' (wine official), changing the meaning from a substance to a person/office.
